response.overview: A group of young people hang out at a house party. 19-year-old Keto, who arrives earlier than her friend, tries to remain unnoticed. The others are having fun, gossiping and discussing their problems. A common theme runs through the conversations: the breakup of a popular couple — Anka and Andro. Andro's sudden interest in Keto sparks intrigue among the group.
